name: Dumbbell Devil Press
steps: Grip two hexagonal dumbbells on the floor shoulder-width apart, jump your feet back into a plank, and lower your chest to the floor.
Press off the floor and jump your feet forward outside the dumbbells into a wide hinged stance with a flat back.
Swing the dumbbells back between your thighs, then drive your hips explosively forward to snatch both bells straight overhead.
Lower the dumbbells under control back to your shoulders and then to the floor to start the next repetition.
tips: Land with wide, flat feet and a braced flat back before swinging the dumbbells overhead.
Drive the overhead finish through your hips rather than muscling the dumbbells up with your lower back.
